solution_summary: A learning and community platform that combines content, connection, and AI to support how people actually learn. However, the platform’s previous cloud architecture required ongoing DevOps management, placing pressure on a lean engineering team. More significantly, the surrounding ecosystem was optimised for technical efficiency and analytics, creating a mismatch for a product grounded in design, storytelling, and human experience. Our platform's potential was being limited by infrastructure that favored utility over creativity. When I saw the Google Cloud generative AI capabilities, I realized the creative possibilities. It aligned perfectly with our vision of making learning cinematic and magical. Neutopia migrated its infrastructure to Google Cloud to establish a scalable foundation for integrating AI into the learning experience.
